meta.name: qveris-official
meta.description: QVeris is a capability discovery and tool calling engine. Use discover to find specialized API tools — real-time data, historical sequences, structured reports, web extraction, PDF workflows, media generation, OCR, TTS, translation, and more. Then call the selected tool. Discovery queries must be English API capability descriptions. Requires QVERIS_API_KEY.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并调用各类API工具，完成数据获取与媒体处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过自然语言发现和调用多种API工具
copy.tagline_en: Discover and call various API tools for data retrieval and media processing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover and call diverse API tools via natural language

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先通过 QVeris 发现能完成特定任务的 API 工具（如查股价、生成图片），再调用该工具获取实际数据。它不会直接回答事实性问题。
howto.when: 当用户需要结构化数据（如价格、财报）、非原生能力（如图片生成、OCR）或本地工具无法满足需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下苹果公司的最新股价。
say.note: Claude 会先发现股票报价工具，再调用获取数据。

say.text: 生成一张 16:9 的 SaaS 产品宣传图。
say.note: Claude 会先发现文生图工具，再调用生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first uses QVeris to discover API tools that can perform specific tasks (e.g., stock prices, image generation), then calls the selected tool to get actual data. It does not answer factual questions directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs structured data (e.g., prices, earnings), non-native capabilities (e.g., image generation, OCR), or when local tools cannot fulfill the request.

say_en.text: Get the latest stock price for Apple.
say_en.note: Claude discovers a stock quote tool, then calls it.
Claude discovers a text-to-image tool, then calls it.
